_README: Fallback names for the 21 Staff candidates (SF01-21).
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json, booster_standing.json and
WHY THIS EXISTS. The workbook's Staff tab has a Name column, but it is
empty for all 21 rows today. Rather than block the Recruitment shop on
that, this file supplies a name for each staff_id, drafted by Claude and
shown to Cameron for approval on 2026-09-22.
HOW IT IS USED. export_data.py reads this file after the Staff tab and
fills in 'name' for any row whose workbook Name cell is still blank. The
workbook always wins: the moment Cameron types a real name into the Name
column and re-exports, that name is used instead and this file's entry
for that staff_id is simply never read again. Nothing here is canon —
it is a placeholder roster waiting to be overtaken by the workbook.
A row here for a staff_id the workbook no longer has does nothing; a
staff_id the workbook has and this file does not is left with a null
name and the exporter warns about it.
